description.value: A Snaw-naw-as First Nation-operated campground on the Nanoose Bay shoreline north of Nanaimo, with sweeping views across the Salish Sea toward the Winchelsea islands; the park skews heavily RV with hookups, but non-serviced tent sites are available and full amenities (showers, flush washrooms, store) are on-site.

address.value: 101 Snaw-Naw-As Road, Lantzville, BC V0R 2H0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and provides strong primary evidence. The campground explicitly lists hot showers, laundry facilities, free Wi-Fi, water hookups, and an on-site store selling snacks, drinks, wood, and ice. The site is primarily RV-focused (73 RV sites) with no specific mention of hiker/biker sites or tent-only areas. A name discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Snaw Naw As Campground' (no hyphens) while the website consistently uses 'Snaw-Naw-As Campground'.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Snaw Naw As Campground' (no hyphens) but the website consistently uses 'Snaw-Naw-As Campground' with hyphens — OSM tag should be corrected.
No street address available in OSM or on the website; only a general description of 'Nanoose Bay, just north of Nanaimo' is provided.
OSM record has no phone number; phone sourced from website only (250-933-2505).
Campground is primarily RV-focused (73 RV sites); no explicit mention of tent-only or hiker/biker-specific sites — suitability for cycle tourists without RVs is unclear.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-amenitied campground operated by an Indigenous community on the Vancouver Island Cycling Route corridor, with showers, laundry, water, WiFi, and an on-site store — a clear benefit to touring cyclists.
